question: In 2023, which Indian-origin scientist won the Spinoza Prize, also known as the Dutch Nobel Prize?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Joyeeta Gupta.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Joyeeta Gupta is an **environmental scientist** known for work in environmental governance, law, and policy.
 
• She has a strong focus on sustainability, climate change, and water management.
 
• Joyeeta Gupta is a professor at the **University of Amsterdam in the Netherlands.**
 
• She authored some important books which are: **The History of Global Climate Governance, Climate Change, Forests, and REDD: Lessons for Institutional Design.**
 
• She published journals such as **Global Environmental Change, Environmental Science & Policy and Climate Policy. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Usha Barwale-Zehr** is a notable figure in the field of agricultural biotechnology.
 
• She has played a pivotal role in** introducing and developing genetically modified (GM) crops** in India.
 
• Usha Barwale-Zehr is the** Chief Technology Officer** of **Maharashtra Hybrid Seeds Company (Mahyco).**
 
• **Partha Pratim Majumder **is an Indian scientist have contributions to the fields of **statistical genetics, human genetics, and genomics.**
 
• He is the founding director of **National Institute of Biomedical Genomics (NIBMG).**
 
• His important scientific journals, are: **Nature, Science, Nature Genetics, and The American Journal of Human Genetics.**
 
• **D. Sivananda Pai** is an Indian meteorologist known for contributions to the **field of climatology and weather forecasting in India.**
 
• His important contributions include **Monsoon Forecasting, ****Climate Change Studies **and **Climate Models.**
 
• He developed the **I****ndigenous Monsoon Mission** model that enhances short to medium-range weather forecasts and seasonal predictions.
